chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
A little that is consistent is better than much that brings satiety/disgust.
ai.seo_question: What is better: many sporadic deeds or few consistent ones?
ai.summary: This maxim, often cited in Shia ethical literature as a cornerstone of *Murmurat al-Dhikr* (continuous remembrance), emphasizes the spiritual efficacy of constancy (*istiqamah*) over intensity. It reflects the practical wisdom of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) in guiding believers to avoid the burnout associated with sporadic, excessive devotion, thereby ensuring long-term spiritual sustainability.
